Mullins represented Harlequin FC and won a single cap for England in 1989. [ 1 ] Early life [ edit ] Andy Mullins was born on 12 December 1964 in Eltham. [ 1 ] He was educated at Dulwich College and Durham University , where he was a member of Hatfield College . [ 2 ] He spent a year between school and university in the British Army .
